commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot from Duke to Mochi and implement Level-0 greeting
Implement Level-1 echo: echo commands and exit on bye
Implement Level-2 add/list: store tasks and display them on request
Implement mark command to mark tasks as done
Implement unmark command to reverse done status
Add Task class and refactor Mochi to use it (A-Classes)
Support todo, deadline, and event task types
Add Todo, Deadline, Event subclasses of Task (A-Inheritance)
Add test-ui skill and UI test plan for regression testing
Handle unknown commands and empty todo descriptions
Handle all invalid commands via MochiException (A-Exceptions)
Add error-handling test cases to UI test plan
Implement delete command to remove tasks
Store tasks in an ArrayList instead of a fixed-size array (A-Collections)
Add delete test cases to UI test plan
Introduce a TaskType enum to represent task types (A-Enums)
commitResults.messageBody:
The task type is the natural candidate for an enum: each subclass
currently hardcodes its own display symbol ('T', 'D', 'E') as a string
literal. Add a TaskType enum (TODO, DEADLINE, EVENT) carrying that
symbol, store the type on the Task base class, and have the subclasses
pass it up instead of repeating the literal. This removes the duplicated
tag constants and gives the type a first-class identity that the upcoming
save/load increment (Level-7) will also need.

Command verbs were considered as an alternative enum but rejected: the
short, tested if-else chain in Mochi.handleCommand would only gain a
mapping layer, whereas the task type is domain data.

commitResults.messageTitle: Save and load tasks from disk automatically (Level-7)
commitResults.messageBody:
Add file-based persistence so tasks survive across sessions. On startup,
Mochi loads any previously saved tasks from data/tasks.txt; after every
add, mark, unmark, or delete it writes the current list back out.

Design:
- Storage: handles file I/O. Creates data directory and an empty file
  if either does not exist at startup (handles the first-run case).
  Corrupted lines are silently skipped.
- TaskList: wraps List of Task; every mutating operation (add, remove,
  mark, unmark) calls Storage.saveTasks to keep the file in sync.
- Task.toFileString and Task.fromFileString: serialise/deserialise using
  the pipe-delimited format with the TaskType tag letter.
- Mochi: loads via Storage on startup, delegates mutations to TaskList.

Also:
- Updated test-ui runner to clean the data directory between test cases
  so saved tasks do not leak across tests.
- Added data/ to .gitignore.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-Level-7' into master (Level-7: Save)
Teach Mochi to understand dates (Level-8)
commitResults.messageBody:
Store deadline and event dates as java.time.LocalDate instead of plain
strings. Accept yyyy-mm-dd (ISO) format on input and display dates as
MMM d yyyy (e.g., Oct 15 2019) using Locale.ENGLISH.

Changes:
- Deadline and Event now hold LocalDate fields; constructors accept
  LocalDate directly.
- Mochi parses /by, /from, /to arguments with LocalDate.parse and
  throws MochiException on non-ISO dates.
- Task.fromFileString reads ISO dates from the data file; corrupted
  dates are rejected as corrupted data.
- Tests updated to use ISO dates; added test 10 (date formatting) and
  test 11 (invalid date format error).

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-Level-8' into master (Level-8: Dates and Times)
Refactor into OOP design with Command pattern (A-MoreOOP + A-Packages)
commitResults.messageBody:
Extract closely related code into well-defined classes following good
OOP principles:

Classes:
- Ui: all user interaction (welcome, goodbye, errors, task display)
- Parser: static parse() converts raw user input to Command objects
- Command hierarchy: abstract Command with execute() and isExit()
  - ExitCommand, ListCommand, MarkCommand, UnmarkCommand, DeleteCommand
  - AddTodoCommand, AddDeadlineCommand, AddEventCommand
- Storage: now accepts a configurable file path
- TaskList: unchanged (already well-factored)
- Mochi: main class with constructor + run() loop

Packages:
- mochi: Mochi, Parser, Storage, TaskList, MochiException
- mochi.command: Command and all concrete commands
- mochi.task: Task, Todo, Deadline, Event, TaskType
- mochi.ui: Ui

The main loop now reads:
  Command c = Parser.parse(fullCommand);
  c.execute(tasks, ui);
  isExit = c.isExit();

This replaces the 80-line if-else chain with polymorphic dispatch.
Each command class owns its own validation and execution logic.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-A-Gradle' into master (A-Gradle)
Add JUnit tests for Parser and Task (A-JUnit)
commitResults.messageBody:
ParserTest (15 tests): verifies that Parser.parse() returns the correct
Command type for each verb, and throws MochiException with the expected
message for invalid inputs (unknown verb, missing task number, missing
/by /from /to, etc.).

TaskTest (16 tests): verifies Task.fromFileString() round-trips through
toFileString() for all three task types (Todo, Deadline, Event) in both
done and not-done states. Also tests error handling for corrupted data:
too few parts, invalid done flag, unknown type, missing date fields,
and unparseable dates. Tests markAsDone/markAsNotDone status flipping.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Javadoc comments to all public classes and methods (A-JavaDoc)
commitResults.messageBody:
Add descriptive Javadoc to public constructors and methods across all
packages: Mochi, TaskList, Task, Todo, Deadline, Event, TaskType,
MochiException, and all Command subclasses. Override methods inherit
parent Javadoc via {@inheritDoc}.

Stretch goal: header comments now cover all non-private classes,
constructors, and methods.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add SE-EDU Java and Git coding standard skills (A-CodingStandard)
commitResults.messageBody:
Create project-specific skills to enforce SE-EDU conventions:

- seedu-java-coding-standard: intermediate-level Java coding rules
  (naming, layout, statements, comments) from se-education.org
- seedu-git-standard: commit message and branch naming conventions

Update AGENTS.md to mandate these standards for all code and commits.
The existing codebase already conforms to the SE-EDU Java standard.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add find command for keyword search (Level-9)
commitResults.messageBody:
Implement 'find <keyword>' that searches task descriptions for the
given keyword and displays matching tasks. The search is case-sensitive
and matches against the full toString() representation of each task.

New files:
- FindCommand: streams task list and filters by keyword containment
- Parser: 'find' verb with empty-arg validation
- Ui.showMatchingTasks(): displays matching tasks with numbering

Test cases 12-13 added to verify find with results and no results.
